notes: Panel: the black home pages (Big clock, Centre stage, Music, Flight, Calm) now show up under Edit, then Pages, then Add page.
Panel: five new themes in soft dark colours: Graphite (like the Control Hub app), Slate, Ocean, Forest and Mocha. Edit, then Look, then Theme (or one page's ✏ in Pages).
Control Hub has a new dark grey look and a new Overview: status, updates, a drawing of your panel page, now playing, your last flight and quick actions.
Real logos on Connections, a new Settings page with your accent colour, and the window remembers its size.
FlightLine matches the new look, with airline logos on routes and in the logbook.
Panel weather: DMI's sharper forecast, decimals, feels like, wind and 'Rain in 20 min'.
